members.author: MukundaKatta
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: MCPError subclasses (specifically UrlElicitationRequiredError) fail to survive pickle round-trips. Default Exception pickling reconstructs via `cls(*self.args)`, but `self.args` is set by MCPError.__init__ to `(code, message, data)` — which doesn't match UrlElicitationRequiredError's `(elicitations, message=None)` constructor, raising a TypeError on unpickle (tracked as #2431). Both PRs add a custom reconstruction path in src/mcp/shared/exceptions.py that special-cases UrlElicitationRequiredError to use `from_error()`/`from_error_data()` instead of the raw constructor.
